import griffe
import tempfile
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import zipfile
import tarfile

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmpdir:
    tmpdir = Path(tmpdir)
    
    # Download click==8.1.7 from PyPI to temporary directory
    subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "download", "click==8.1.7", "--no-deps", "-d", str(tmpdir)],
        check=True,
        capture_output=True
    )
    
    # Find and extract the distribution
    dist_file = next(tmpdir.glob("click*"))
    extract_dir = tmpdir / "src"
    extract_dir.mkdir()
    
    if dist_file.suffix == ".whl":
        with zipfile.ZipFile(dist_file) as zf:
            zf.extractall(extract_dir)
    else:  # .tar.gz
        with tarfile.open(dist_file) as tf:
            tf.extractall(extract_dir)
    
    # Use griffe's GriffeLoader to load the package
    loader = griffe.GriffeLoader(search_paths=[str(extract_dir)])
    package = loader.load("click")
    print(package.name)
